item.title: FAQs
item.description:
How Do I Start Using The Space?

Drop in during any open hours, and all that’s needed is to fill out safety waiver.

Do I Need Membership?

No, there will be a free-to-use work area available to everyone. but power tools and machinery, materials, and reserved space will have fees.

What’s Included in a Membership?

The base-level membership will include free use of power tools, machinery, and space reservations.

item.title: About Us
item.description:
Non profit Shared community workshop for individuals to work on crafting, art, or skilled trade projects
Provide third space for casual or serious(re-word) use
Accessible to anyone
Contribute to community fund intended for opening smaller spaces in other neighbourhoods, specialized to align with local needs
Take initiative to reduce waste, encourage reuse, and reclaim old or unused materials
Use in-house software for inventory management and space reservation that can be accessed by everyone. Software will be given for free to new spaces opened through the community fund
